newsitem.title: DUBAI: Perry meets Saudi Arabia's King on Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Perry meets Saudi Arabia's King on Iraq.

text.p: U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry, on a mission to three Gulf Arab states to secure support for a possible U.S. military showdown with Iraq, on Sunday met Saudia Arabia's King Fahd in Jeddah, Saudi television said.
The television said Perry handed over to the Saudi ruler a letter from U.S. President Bill Clinton. It gave no details of the contents.
The meeting at Salam palace was also attended by Crown Prince Abdullah and Defence Minister Prince Sultan, it said.

Diplomats say Saudi Arabia, Washington's most powerful Gulf ally and with Kuwait and Bahrain one of three countries visited by Perry, was unlikely to back more missile attacks against Iraq or give open approval for a continuing American military buildup in the oil-rich region.
